editorial.name: TYPE01
editorial.descriptionZh: 字型与平面设计杂志站，文章按 3D Type、Kinetic Typography、Industry Interviews 等分类归档，另有 TYPE DEPARTMENT 与 TYPE TUTORIALS，STORE 卖杂志订阅。
editorial.takeawayZh: 读字型与动态排版的报道，顺手订杂志
editorial.noteZh: 黑底顶栏一行 TYPE01 加 ABOUT / STUDIO / TYPEONE MAGAZINE / CATEGORIES / STORE / TYPE DEPARTMENT / TYPE TUTORIALS / SUBSCRIBE，右端一个 £0.00 的购物车。首屏是一张 NikeLab SNKRS 现场照片，压着标题 When a Studio Becomes the Message: Inside Teleport 与白底 FULL READ 按钮。往下接着 Risk, play and criticality: What Falmouth University's collaboration with Birmingham Design Festival teaches future creatives、Relentless Momentum: The Explosive Identity of Young Guns 23，以及 Jakob Runge on TypeMates' Gregory Grotesk、Inside Zed, Typotheque's 500‑style family 这类访谈，页脚是 STORE / My Account / Magazine Subscriptions / Shipping & Delivery / Refunds & Returns 的客服分区。
editorial.pricing: Freemium（文章免费读，STORE 卖杂志订阅与印刷品）

reasons.statement: 交付物是一篇篇署名报道与访谈（FULL READ、Editor's Picks、Industry Interviews，路径如 /when-a-studio-becomes-the-message-inside-teleport），用户动作是读，归书籍、文章、博客、杂志与通讯。
站内 /store 与 /magazine-subscriptions 是杂志订阅的衍生入口，主交付物仍是文章，因此不归模板或素材市场。
